## Problem and behavior

Describe the concrete problem and the observable behavior before and after this change. English or 简体中文 is welcome.

## Verification

List the commands or manual checks you ran, their results, and any skipped or untested cases. Explain a compatibility or evidence tradeoff when relevant.

## Review checklist

- [ ] I have checked that the diff contains no credentials, confidential reports or private source.
- [ ] I have included relevant regression evidence for behavior changes, or explained why it does not apply.
- [ ] I have checked English/Chinese text and documentation when user-visible behavior changes.
- [ ] I have considered saved-review identifiers, export compatibility and source-scope reporting where applicable.
- [ ] I have retained attribution and checked third-party notices for dependency changes.

Use [private reporting](https://github.com/Serennity007/xss-audit-desktop/security/advisories/new) for undisclosed vulnerabilities in this application.
